name: Purified Kor Gem
summary: At Jordan Stilwell’s forge outside Ironforge, a Purified Kor Gem is needed for a weapon of the Light. First, the corrupted stone must be cleansed by elven magic.

sections.title: From Corruption to Sanctity
sections.body: A Corrupted Kor Gem is held by naga in Blackfathom Deeps beneath the coast of Ashenvale. A paladin takes it to Thundris Windweaver, a night elf in Auberdine. Thundris draws on arcane and natural arts to purge the stone’s aquatic and shadowy taint. The cleanse leaves a Purified Kor Gem, fit to channel holy power.

sections.title: The Smith's Masterpiece
sections.body: Jordan Stilwell, a human weaponsmith outside Ironforge, needs the gem to forge a masterwork weapon. He has long held designs for an arm worthy of the Silver Hand, but lacked the rare materials to make it. The Purified Kor Gem, Whitestone Oak Lumber, and rare ore provide the spiritual core for channeling a paladin’s righteous wrath.

faq.q: What is the Purified Kor Gem used for?
aliases: why do i need kor gem
faq.answer: The gem goes to Jordan Stilwell, the blacksmith outside Ironforge in Dun Morogh. He uses it to forge a consecrated weapon for a paladin undertaking their trials.
Naga hold the corrupted stone in Blackfathom Deeps, beneath the coast of Ashenvale.
Thundris Windweaver, a night elf in Auberdine, cleanses the Corrupted Kor Gem and restores it to a purified state.

faq.q: Can any adventurer make use of the Purified Kor Gem?
aliases: can anyone use purified kor gem
faq.answer: Paladins undergoing the Test of Righteousness seek the gem. Jordan Stilwell crafts for holy warriors who bring him the purified crystal and other rare materials.

angles.text: As a paladin, you prove your devotion by acquiring and cleansing this gem, then carrying it from Kalimdor to Dun Morogh to forge a weapon of the Light.
As an Alliance member, you rely on night elven wisdom in Auberdine to aid a human smith working on the slopes of Dun Morogh.
